'''Tookreek's Cantina''', also known as the '''Tookreek cantina''', was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Dreviad Outpost]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was named after its owner, the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Tookreek]].<ref name="TOR" />
